JDU Sushasan Diwas: bihar men JDU ne nitish kumar ke shasankal ke 21 sal ka jashn manaya...JDU ne sushasan divas ke bahane nitish kumar ke shasan ki uplabdhiyan ginaee.... lekin sushasan ke is jashn par siyasat ka rang bhi charh gaya hai...RJD ne saval uthaya ki aakhir kis bat ka jashn manaya ja raha hai?....kangres ne jediyu ko hari aur thaki huee parti karar diya... vahin jediyu aur bijepi ne nitish kumar ke vikas karyon ko aitihasik batate hue vipaksh par palatvar kiya hai...riport dekhie...
